_comment: Copy to ~/.config/armamentarium/desktop.json. Controls how armamentarium stops/starts Claude Desktop (for `armamentarium desktop ...` and `dock --restart`). 'command' is the launch argv, 'env' is extra environment (e.g. native Wayland), 'process_match' is matched against the process executable (argv[0]) to find running instances, 'term_timeout_s' is how long to wait for a graceful SIGTERM before --force may SIGKILL (Electron is multi-process, so keep this generous), 'restart_settle_s' is the pause after the last process exits before relaunch so the single-instance lock/socket releases. Values below match a claude-desktop-unofficial install on Linux.
